title: Chat view with the "show terminal" switch as the agent tab body
summary: The chat view could not be built: agent tabs only ever hold a terminal agent, and nothing starts a chat agent behind a tab. No code was written; issue #156 (agent runtime starts each agent tab as a chat agent) was filed and set as a blocker of issues #94 and #96.
friction: Issue #94 (chat view) and issue #96 (support agent tab) were labelled agent-ready but unbuildable: the PRD split never cut a story that makes an agent tab a chat agent; a dev run was spent finding it. Filed as issue #156, which waits on issue #123 (Agent SDK terms).
